digest.component_or_area: LLM gate structured-output routing and failure classification
propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify step fails on Bedrock with HTTP 400 ValidationException when native structured output is enabled for sonnet-4-6, because the verification contracts carry 22-36 optional parameters that exceed Anthropic's documented grammar-compilation complexity limits.

The failing output mode (NativeOutput) was enabled by rebar:18ae's exact-model-id capability override that flips sonnet-4-6 from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput, causing rebar to send JSON Schemas to Bedrock for constrained decoding grammar compilation.
The defect is a regression introduced 2026-08-05 00:48 (commit 6c8daf7945); the same contracts pass identically within 11.2s on PromptedOutput mode, proving the remedy direction works today.

Bedrock schema-complexity rejections (180-185s compile timeout or 'Schema is too complex' error) must be classified distinctly from generic provider outages, and the operator message must name the model and contract to enable diagnosis.

The fix gates native structured output selection on both (a) whether the installed stack supports outputConfig at all, and (b) a measured complexity bound (16 optional / 12 union) that sits inside the observed 14-passes-22-fails boundary.
